meta.name: to-tickets
meta.description: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker — edges as text in one file per ticket locally, or native blocking links on a real tracker.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把计划拆解成带依赖关系的工单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常把大计划拆成小任务并需要管理任务依赖
copy.tagline_en: Turn a plan into dependency-aware tickets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often break large plans into small tasks and need to track dependencies

howto.what: 把计划、规格或当前对话拆成一组任务单，标明彼此的依赖关系。拆分列表先给你确认，再按依赖顺序发布到本地文件或已配置的跟踪器（GitHub、Linear 等）；可立即开始的任务标为 ready-for-agent。
howto.when: 当用户要求把计划、规格或当前对话拆成任务单时触发；若用户给出来源（如文件路径、issue 编号或网址），会先读取其内容。

say.text: 帮我把这份产品规格拆成任务单，标好依赖关系。
say.note: Claude 会先给出拆分列表让你确认。

say.text: 把当前对话里的开发计划拆成一系列 tickets，按依赖排序。
say.note: 会逐项列出每个 ticket 的标题和阻塞项。

say.text: 将 issue #42 拆成可独立交付的切片，并标明阻塞关系。
say.note: 若已配置跟踪器，确认后直接发布。

howto.what_en: Break a plan, spec, or conversation into tickets. Each lists its blocking tickets and acceptance criteria. You approve the list first; then tickets are published in dependency order to local files or a configured tracker (GitHub, Linear, etc.). Immediately startable ones get ready-for-agent.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to break a plan, spec, or conversation into tickets. If a source path/issue/URL is given, it is fetched and read first.

say_en.text: Break this product spec into tickets with dependencies marked.
say_en.note: Claude shows the breakdown for approval first.

say_en.text: Turn the dev plan in this conversation into a ticket list, ordered by dependency.
say_en.note: Lists each ticket's title and blockers.

say_en.text: Split issue #42 into independently deliverable slices, showing blocking edges.
say_en.note: If a tracker is configured, it publishes after confirmation.
